text: Hosted payment pages are optimized for phones, tablets, and all device sizes
quote: Mollie's hosted payment pages have been optimized for devices of all common brands and sizes, including phones and tablets.

text: Mollie JS provides card-field components that keep the integration PCI-DSS SAQ-A compliant
quote: Mollie JS is a set of Javascript APIs that allow you to add the fields needed for credit card holder data to your own checkout, in a way that is fully PCI-DSS SAQ-A compliant.

text: Payment Links API generates shareable no-code payment links via email or chat

text: Supports recurring payments for subscriptions and automatic credit top-ups
quote: Recurring payments can be used to charge customers on a regular basis or to offer automatic top-ups with credits-based services.

text: Refunds can be issued manually from the Mollie dashboard
quote: you can also create refunds manually via the Mollie Web app.

text: Chargebacks API lets you retrieve details of disputes on your account
quote: The Chargebacks API then allows you to retrieve details of the chargebacks that took place on your account.

text: Settlement Report gives a full breakdown of a payout to help reconcile transactions
quote: Settlement Report gives you a complete breakdown of the data included in a specific payout... helping you reconcile your transactions.

text: Balances API exposes real-time and historical balance data for reconciliation
quote: The Balances API allows you to retrieve real-time as well as historical information about your Mollie balance.

text: Supports accepting payments in currencies beyond EUR via v2 APIs
quote: Mollie enables you to accept payments in currencies beyond EUR through its v2 APIs, allowing international customers to transact in their preferred currency.

text: Mollie Connect lets platforms/marketplaces offer branded payment and money-management features to merchants
quote: Mollie Connect lets software platforms and marketplaces offer payment and money management capabilities to their merchants under their own brand.

text: Application Fees let a platform collect a commission on every payment processed for a connected account
quote: Application Fees allow your platform to collect a fee on every payment you process on behalf of a connected account.

text: Webhooks deliver real-time status updates, e.g. when a payment is paid
quote: Webhooks are used to process real-time status updates, for example when a payment is paid.
